uncertainty.method: standard error of 8 batch means over the averaging window
uncertainty.repeatability_note: Two independent runs of the installed build at 0 deg (yaw00_dx8 and yaw00_dx8_snap) differ by 0.041 N (0.5 %).

summary.method: Lattice Boltzmann D3Q19, regularized BGK + Smagorinsky LES (Cs 0.17), half-way bounce-back walls, momentum-exchange forces
summary.force_average: every step of the window (rebuilt from the slab profile)

validation.note: Same solver and wall treatment. At the bike's resolution (main tubes about 6-8 cells across) absolute drag reads high; differences between configurations are the reliable output.

history.note: Recorded every 10th step; shifted by the window offset (+12.5 N) to the every-step mean.
